objective_value: <float or null> Total weighted deviation cost summing berth-position and start-time penalties across all vessels.

vessels.berth: <int> Index of the berth assigned to the vessel.
vessels.start_time: <int> Time step at which the vessel begins service.
vessels.end_time: <int> Time step at which the vessel completes service.
vessels.profile: <int> Index of the QC assignment profile assigned to the vessel.
